messages:
Emily: thanks everyone for the great all-hands. wanted to capture a few follow-up Qs that came up about the API/Console/Optimize timelines — posting here so leadership can confirm.
Maria: thanks emily — happy to answer. ask away.
Rahul: on Optimize: is the public beta still targeted for late Q2 or did that slide? there was a convo about quantization profiles that sounded like it might push things.
Maria: short answer: beta still late Q2, GA targeted Q4. quantization profiles are a staging item — we'll ship a conservative set in beta, add advanced heuristics during Q3.
Diego: can you clarify "conservative set"? will it include 4-bit quantization recommendations for smaller models?
Maria: yes — beta will recommend int8/4 variants when we have high-confidence perf+quality numbers. production auto-suggestion (per workload) is Q3.
Lily: for Redwood Console changes (routes + rollout UX) — is that a separate release or tied to API versioning? customers asked about migrating canaries.
Maria: Console UI changes will ship as part of a Console release (no breaking API changes). routing policy UX will be available in console beta alongside Optimize beta. API is stable; we won't force client changes.
Rahul: for Dedicated customers who want early access to the new routing policy, is there a sign-up or RFC?
Emily: yep, we're opening an early access form next week. engineering will coordinate capacity for a small cohort.
Diego: any expected perf/latency SLO impacts when routing starts using fallback model variants? ops is worried about tail latency.
Maria: fallback is asynchronous by default for throughput-sensitive routes. immediate fallback (sync) is an opt-in and will have documented tail-latency tradeoffs. We'll publish a guidance doc w/ numbers before beta.
Rahul: can we get a short checklist for migrations? teams want a concrete path (dev -> canary -> prod) with flags.
Emily: working on a migration checklist now — will post in #devex and attach to the Console beta invite. it will include example rollout configs and a sample canary policy.
deploy-bot: [notice] Console-beta branch deployed to staging (staging.redwood.internal) at commit 3f9a2b4 — smoke tests passed.
Lily: thanks — can you add a note about telemetry breakpoints? some customers require event parity before they flip routing.
Maria: good call. we'll add a telemetry parity test in the checklist and add a telemetry toggle in Console (hidden behind EA flag).
Emily: awesome — if folks on this thread want to help review the checklist or beta docs, ping me or drop comments. i'll consolidate and post an ETA by EOD friday. :thumbsup:
Rahul: i'll review the checklist.
Diego: same here.
Maria: allocating two SREs to the parity tests.
Emily: closing the loop here — i'll update the all-hands notes and send the EA form link when it's live. thanks all!
